explication: EhPanda is an unofficial iOS client for E-Hentai. The main user journey is to browse or search galleries, open gallery details and associated material, then view previews and read pages; deep links can enter that flow directly. Gallery metadata, reading progress, and preview URLs are backed by local persistence, while requests and HTML parsing support the remote catalog. The tree also shows account, favorites, history, rankings, comments, torrents, and settings features. Sampled excerpts establish only some wiring, so uncertain connections between unsampled feature reducers and views are omitted.
